title: One America Movement public location semantics
summary: InfluenceWatch labels the Bowie address as headquarters, while One America Movement's first-party site currently supports the same address specifically as a donation-mailing address; headquarters semantics remain unresolved.

data.question: Does current public evidence support treating One America Movement's Bowie donation-mailing address as its headquarters?
data.method: Compared the current InfluenceWatch profile with One America Movement first-party donation, contact, and 2026 hiring surfaces plus the current public nonprofit filing index.
data.framework: Preserve source-specific predicates; prefer first-party evidence for current organizational-location semantics; do not collapse mailing, office, registered-office, principal-place, and headquarters predicates.
data.scope: Public organizational identity and location only.
findings: InfluenceWatch currently labels 4450 Mitchellville Road 1021, Bowie, Maryland as One America Movement's headquarters.
One America Movement's current donation page publishes 4450 Mitchellville Road #1021, Bowie, MD 20716 specifically as the address to mail donations.
The current first-party contact page does not publish a headquarters address, while a 2026 Development Director posting describes its location as Washington, DC Metro Area.
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer corroborates EIN 84-5006315 and Bowie, Maryland as the organization's filing locality without establishing the street address as headquarters.
conclusions: The Bowie address is defensible as a current public organizational donation/mailing address.

The available first-party evidence reviewed in this pass does not independently establish that address as headquarters, so the InfluenceWatch headquarters label should remain attributed secondary-source evidence pending stronger first-party or filing semantics.
recommendations: Keep mailing-address and headquarters predicates distinct in normalized ingestion.
Resolve the latest Form 990 header and any first-party legal/contact page that explicitly designates principal office or headquarters before promoting the Bowie address.
counterarguments: The organization may use the Bowie mailing address as its operational headquarters without labeling it that way on the current public website.
limitations: This pass does not infer a headquarters from staff job geography or donation-mailing instructions.
No private addresses or coordinates were collected.
unresolved: What current first-party or filing source, if any, explicitly designates One America Movement's headquarters or principal office?
